# Every test file under .github/scripts (*.test.*, subdirectories included) and
# where it runs (.github/scripts/fork-ci-tests.cjs checks this list).
#   <test>                  run by the workflows job, by extension (sh, py, cjs, mjs, js)
#   <test> run by <file>    run by <file>, which must name the test's path (not one
#                           of upstream's workflows: they are disabled in the fork)
# A present test that is not listed fails. A listed file that is not present yet
# is a note; one that was present and then deleted fails.
.github/scripts/fork-ci-tests.test.cjs
.github/scripts/fork-fleet.test.py
.github/scripts/fork-follow.test.sh
.github/scripts/fork-release-workflow.test.py
.github/scripts/fork-release.test.sh
.github/scripts/fork-schema-check.test.cjs
.github/scripts/fork-secret-scan.test.sh
.github/scripts/fork-test-shards.test.cjs
.github/scripts/fork-tests-drift.test.cjs

# Upstream's tests, run where fork-tests.yml follows upstream's ci.yml.
.github/scripts/check-nightly-release.test.cjs run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml
.github/scripts/mobile-preview-comment.test.cjs run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml
.github/scripts/stage-preview-bundle.test.py run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml
.github/scripts/test-delta.test.cjs run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml
.github/scripts/vercel-deployment-output.test.cjs run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml
# Upstream runs this one from thread-transfer-report.yml (workflow_run of the disabled CI).
.github/scripts/thread-transfer-report.test.cjs run by .github/workflows/fork-tests.yml
# Release Smoke runs scripts/release-smoke.ts, which runs this one.
.github/scripts/relay-state-output.test.cjs run by scripts/release-smoke.ts
